title: Off the Clock
summary: River asks you to take his phone for one day off, drive him past three temptations to the water tower, and cook a pot of jambalaya with him.
description: River has not taken a day off since the badge. He hands V his phone for one day and asks V to drive him to the water tower near Joss's place, where he will cook.

start.bringUp: River has not taken a day without a case since the badge. He wants you to hold his phone and drive him to the water tower near Joss's place, where he will cook. Bring it up as a favour, and say you will hold him to it.

roadside.name: the roadside with the smoking car

street.name: the street where a man is standing

stop.name: the roadside stop with the cruiser

tower.name: the water tower near Joss's place

RW6.open.01.text: I want one day. No phone. You hold it. If I reach for it, say something unkind.

RW6.open.02.text: Here. Phone. Don't answer it. Don't look at it. Don't tell me who called.

RW6.open.03.text: I'm bad at this. If I start asking about suspects, kick me.

RW6.open.04.text: What counts as a day off, for you?

RW6.s3.01.text: Where we're going has no signal, no cases. Just dust.

RW6.s3.02.text: That car. Smoke. Don't. No. Okay, a little. Pull over?

RW6.s3.03.text: Quick. Two minutes. I won't read his plates.

RW6.s3.04.text: Good. Drive. I'm fine. I'm not fine.

RW6.s3.05.text: That man on the left. I know that face. Never mind. Never mind.

RW6.s3.06.text: That's a guy from my old precinct. Keep driving. I mean it. Please.

RW6.bark.hold.b.text: Good call. I hate that it was a good call.

RW6.bark.let.a.text: I know. I know. One thing. Then nothing.

RW6.bark.let.b.text: Don't say anything. I can hear you not saying it.

RW6.s4.01.text: That's it. That's the tower. No suspects in this view.

RW6.s4.02.text: Tomatoes, rice, onions, paprika, thyme, celery, garlic. Stir. Don't let it burn.

RW6.s4.03.text: My secret is nothing special. Patience. And Randy's face when he tastes it.

RW6.s4.04.text: Do you cook for anyone? Or just for the idea of it?

RW6.s4.05.text: Monique and Dorian fight over the last spoon. Randy eats the pot clean. I miss most of it.

RW6.s4.06.text: Have you ever worked so hard at something that you forgot who it was for?

RW6.close.01.text: A whole day. Not one case. I'll deny it under oath.

RW6.close.02.text: I slipped. Twice. Don't tell Harold.

RW6.close.04.text: Went to the tower alone. The pot was fine. You missed it.

g1.asks: What counts as a day off, for you?
g1.know: You know the plan: the phone handover, the drive, and the water tower. You know V's habits.
g1.secret: You have not taken a day off since the badge.
g1.wants: To borrow V's definition of a day off.

g2.know: You know the recipe you just said aloud, and V's food habits.
g2.secret: You cook mainly to keep Randy talking.

g3.asks: Have you ever worked so hard at something that you forgot who it was for?
g3.know: You know the water tower, the meal, and your parents' case in outline only.
g3.secret: That is your entire life so far.

temp1.know: A motorist with a smoking car is waving at the roadside. You want to help, and you know you should not stop.
temp1.secret: You would stop for anyone with a smoking car.
temp1.wants: V to hold you in the seat or let you go.

temp2.asks: That man on the left. I know that face.
temp2.know: A man on the street matches a face on a wanted list.
temp2.secret: You know who he is and what he did.
temp2.wants: V to hold you in the seat or let you go.

temp3.asks: Keep driving. I mean it. Please.
temp3.know: An officer from your old precinct is waving you over from a cruiser.
temp3.secret: You want to go and say hello.

stages.label: River hands V his phone for one day
stages.objective: Take River's phone for one day at V's flat
stages.know: You texted V about one day off, with no phone and no cases. You are waiting for V at V's flat, and you will hand over your phone there.
stages.wants: V to take the phone and keep you from reaching for it.

stages.label: V drives River past the smoking car
stages.objective: Drive River past the smoking car on the roadside
stages.know: V is driving toward the water tower with no phone for River. The first temptation is a motorist at the roadside with a smoking car.
stages.wants: V to keep driving and hold River in the seat.

stages.label: V drives River past the man on the street
stages.objective: Drive River past the man standing on the street
stages.know: You stayed in the seat past the smoking car. The next temptation is a man on the street whom you recognize from a wanted list.
stages.wants: V to keep driving and hold River in the seat again.

stages.label: V drives River past the man on the street after a let
stages.objective: Drive River past the man standing on the street
stages.know: You went after the smoking car for two minutes and came back. The next temptation is a man on the street whom you recognize from a wanted list.
stages.wants: V to keep driving and hold River in the seat this time.

stages.label: V drives River past the cruiser
stages.objective: Drive River past the cruiser at the roadside stop
stages.know: You stayed in the seat through two temptations. The last one is an officer from your old precinct, waving you over from a cruiser at a roadside stop.
stages.wants: V to keep driving and hold River in the seat.

stages.label: V drives River past the cruiser after a let
stages.objective: Drive River past the cruiser at the roadside stop
stages.know: You went off the clock twice already. The last temptation is an officer from your old precinct, waving you over from a cruiser at a roadside stop.
stages.wants: V to keep driving and hold River in the seat.

stages.label: River cooks at the water tower
stages.objective: Cook jambalaya with River at the water tower
stages.know: You have reached the water tower near Joss's place. You are cooking jambalaya on a camp stove, and V is sitting with you.
stages.wants: V to sit with you through the meal.

stages.label: River cooks at the water tower after a slip
stages.objective: Cook jambalaya with River at the water tower
stages.know: You have reached the water tower near Joss's place. You slipped off the clock on the drive, and you are cooking jambalaya on a camp stove with V.
stages.wants: V to sit with you through the meal.

whole-day.memory: You spent a whole day off the clock with River, and he cooked for you at the water tower.

slipped.memory: You and River spent a day off the clock, he slipped on a case or two on the drive, and he cooked for you at the water tower.
